title: BFS / DFS
summary: Compare breadth-first queue traversal with depth-first stack traversal on the same binary tree.

input.hint: JSON object: { tree: level-order values (null for missing nodes), strategy: "BFS" | "DFS" }

visual.representation: Hierarchical binary tree with active/visited nodes and a live queue (BFS) or stack (DFS).

approach.explanation: BFS visits a whole level at a time using a FIFO queue. DFS follows a branch using a LIFO stack (preorder here), pushing right before left so the left child is visited first.
